recent.text: The Dallas Mavericks' bench outscored the Utah Jazz reserves 44-19. Morez Johnson Jr. was plus-20, and Naji Marshall and Santi Aldama were each plus-17. "I thought our bench was awesome tonight," Dusty May said. Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/Bn36HsRCAj

recent.text: Cooper Flagg and Kyrie Irving combined for 23 of the Dallas Mavericks' 32 third-quarter points against the Utah Jazz, and Dallas closed the period on a 19-6 run. Dusty May said they "flipped the switch at half." Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/uzYVPnv9BN
